description: One prompt produces the full kit: logo x4, wide banner x2, alpha stickers x6, teaser, and music. Returns a job_id immediately so the client connection does not have to stay open. Poll get_job for status, progress, and asset links. Music is mixed into the teaser when ffmpeg is available and always returned as its own asset. Tiers: budget ($2.49), standard ($4.49), premium ($6.99).

owns_rights.description: Must be true. Confirms the caller owns or is licensed to request this subject.
